other_conditions: Minimum 50% marks required for classes IX‑X
Minimum 60% marks required for classes XI‑XII
Students scoring 75% or above in the previous class are exempt from the income limit for SC/ST/OBC categories
Repeaters in a particular class are not eligible
Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC) must be issued by the SDM/Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), GNCTD
For SC beneficiaries, a Delhi domicile certificate is accepted if the caste certificate is issued by an authority outside the state
Bank account must be in the name of the student (joint account with parent/guardian is permissible) and seeded with the student’s Aadhaar number
benefits_summary: Scholarship of Rs 5,000 per annum for classes IX–X and Rs 10,000 per annum for classes XI–XII.
documents_required: Domicile Certificate of Delhi (for SC beneficiaries)
